claims: Justin Rose has won one major championship.
Justin Rose won the 2013 U.S. Open at Merion Golf Club.
Justin Rose is an English golfer.
Justin Rose had runner-up finishes at the Masters Tournament in 2015, 2017, and 2025.
Justin Rose's best finish at the Masters Tournament is 2nd/T2 in 2015, 2017, and 2025.
Justin Rose's best finish at The Open Championship is 2nd in 2018 and 2024.
Justin Rose's best finish at the PGA Championship is T3 in 2012.
Justin Rose won the Olympic gold medal at the 2016 Rio Games.
Justin Rose achieved World No. 1 in 2018.
